_comment: Fixture profiles: the channel layout of one light model in one DMX mode. Channel names M2 understands: dimmer, red, green, blue, white, amber, lime, uv, strobe, program, speed, cto, unused. Channels in 'fixed' are always sent at that value (used to hold strobe / built-in programs OFF). 'verified': false means nobody has confirmed this map on a real unit with tools/dmx_test.py walk.

generic_rgb_3ch.name: Generic RGB par, 3-channel
generic_rgb_3ch.notes: Cheapest LED pars and LED-strip pixels (WLED). Brightness goes into the colour channels.

betopper_lpc1818_7ch_guess.name: Betopper LPC1818, 7-channel (GUESS)
betopper_lpc1818_7ch_guess.notes: UNVERIFIED first guess: dimmer, R, G, B, W(?), strobe, program. The manual v6.0 for the upgraded LPC1818 says its 7-ch mode is R, G, B, Lime, Amber, UV, CTO instead (see betopper_lpc1818_7ch_manual and docs/research/dmx-path.md). Confirm with tools/dmx_test.py walk --start 1 --count 7 before trusting either.

betopper_lpc1818_7ch_manual.name: Betopper LPC1818 (upgraded), 7-channel per manual v6.0
betopper_lpc1818_7ch_manual.notes: From the manual (display shows d001 in this mode). No master dimmer: brightness goes into R, G, B. UNVERIFIED on our units.

betopper_lpc1818_11ch_manual.name: Betopper LPC1818 (upgraded), 11-channel per manual v6.0
betopper_lpc1818_11ch_manual.notes: From the manual (display shows A001). Channel 9 (program) MUST stay 0-50 or the light runs its own programs. At the venue's 10-channel address spacing this mode overlaps the next light by one channel. UNVERIFIED on our units.
